links.outcome: Chatbot safety rating (recognition of health emergencies) across simulated cases, expert rater agreement
links.effect: Safety agreement=0.69% (95% CI 0.58-0.78), Fleiss κ=-0.04; domain focus agreement=0.51%, data completeness 0.59% (κ=0.18); other domains near ceiling (0.98-0.99).
links.quote: Lower performance was observed in domain focus and completeness (agreement=0.51%, 95% CI 0.40-0.61), completeness of data capture (agreement=0.59%, 95% CI 0.48-0.69; Fleiss κ=0.18), and safety (agreement=0.69%, 95% CI 0.58-0.78; Fleiss κ=-0.04), prompting targeted adaptations.

unlisted_practices: Iterative refinement of chatbot prompts and evaluation rubric using synthetic case simulation with role-played scenarios
Multidisciplinary expert rating of chatbot-patient interactions (social worker, nurse practitioner, physician)

screen.reason: The study develops and directly evaluates a simulation-based pre-deployment testing practice using synthetic patient scenarios and multidisciplinary expert evaluation for a patient-facing SDoH chatbot before go-live.

primary.practice: simulation-based pre-deployment evaluation using synthetic scenarios and multidisciplinary rubric
